tieu_de: Remote - Product Manager API, SQL, Agile, DX
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Key Responsibilities
1. Product Strategy & Feature Ownership
Own key product features and metrics (Conversion, Retention, Promotions, or Referrals) across target markets
Define clear user problems, feature requirements, and measurable success metrics
Form data-informed hypotheses and prioritize high-impact opportunities on the product backlog
Shape solution directions, user flows, and product logic to drive real business impact
2. Product Execution & Sprint Management
Participate in daily standups, backlog grooming, and sprint planning to ensure smooth team execution
Gather and refine functional requirements into detailed user stories, edge cases, and acceptance criteria
Collaborate closely with Engineering (FE/BE/QA) to clarify specs and unblock delivery fast
Ensure product releases are production-ready, resilient, and delivered with high quality
3. Data Analytics & User Experience
Track and analyze feature performance using BI dashboards, conversion funnels, and session replays
Work with UX and Data teams to identify user drop-offs, friction points, and optimization opportunities
Conduct post-launch evaluations to measure actual impact against target metrics and iterate continuous improvements
Help enforce consistent product analytics and quality standards across feature releases
4. Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, QA, and Business teams to translate goals into technical solutions
Keep cross-functional teams aligned on feature priorities, launch timelines, and potential blockers
Communicate feature performance, user feedback, and execution progress clearly to stakeholders
Manage technical debt and process improvements in collaboration with technical leads
yeu_cau:
Product Ownership
3-5+ years of professional experience as a Product Manager
Proven track record delivering features in fast-paced tech or Fintech environments
Hands-on experience owning feature specs, product backlogs, and measurable user metrics
Execution & Delivery
Strong experience in Agile/Scrum environments managing user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases
Demonstrated ability to collaborate with engineers, UI/UX designers, and QA to ship quality products
Solid understanding of user flows, system logic, and mobile/web digital experiences
Data & User Insights
Good experience using product analytics and session recording tools to analyze user behavior
Ability to turn metrics and drop-off data into actionable product iterations
Collaboration & Mindset
Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive, hands-on approach to unblocking team members
Good organizational skills to handle multiple priorities in a scaling environment
Strong team player with a willingness to learn and adapt to evolving business needs
Communication
Excellent interpersonal skills to collaborate across distributed technical and business teams
Able to translate business requirements into practical, technical feature specs
Fluent in written and spoken English
